user_message: Our Aim is to make the Swinfusion++ as best model as possible ... you can also improve the model if you deem it will improve the model ... I am not saying we are going to cheat the results ... As long as it will be going to be around 3-4 days
decision: No architecture or training change (would invalidate the completed studies and the deadline). Pre-declared inference-only improvement: horizontal-flip test-time augmentation (TTA), evaluated FIRST on source validation and reported as a labelled variant beside the plain result; never selected on test results.

tta.aggregation: mean of clip logits over {identity, flip} before the frozen 7-anchor video mean
tta.selection_rule: TTA variant reported alongside plain; any per-model choice uses source validation only

ensembles: three-seed mean-logit ensemble per model (already in the frozen protocol, D-40)
